Today, I went to court against my abusive ex-boyfriend, who also happens to be a practicing attorney, and I FUCKING WON.

And I cannot begin to explain how satisfying it is to successfully defend myself in court against a man whose literal profession is practicing law.

After spending months recovering from the emotional and psychological consequences of dating a serial cheater who manipulated, deceived, and abused me, I was forced to defend myself against his repeated attempts to obtain a restraining order.

He filed FOUR separate petitions. The first three were denied. His fourth was finally granted, and rather than allow him to weaponize the legal system against me without a fight, I contested it.

Today, I walked into that courtroom, represented myself against an actual attorney, presented my evidence, and WON.

But perhaps one of the most disturbing parts of this entire ordeal has been the involvement of one of the women he cheated on me with. A woman who, mind you, knowingly maintained a relationship with him for THREE YEARS while he was married.

This woman has repeatedly taken to social media to publicly accuse me of stalking, harassment, and abuse.

She’s mentioned me by name, published private text messages I sent my ex during periods of extreme emotional distress, and appointed herself the moral authority on how someone should respond to being abused.

The irony is fucking astounding.

This is the same woman who publicly declared that if I moved to Portland, she hoped I would, because she intended to physically assault me.
goodnight to everyone who doesn’t breed their dogs

when air fryers first became a thing and i didnt know what they were yet, i asked my friend what she wanted for christmas and she kept saying an air fryer. and i just remember thinking to myself, “how the FUCK do you fry air?”

i genuinely wish i was joking.
if there’s one constant in my life, it’s that I’m gonna come home to find socks I’ve already picked up delivered right back to the hallway by my cat.
lmao
I decided today I’m gonna start my professional psychic and tarot business. I’ve done it for friends and family for over 10 years. ▓▓▓
Visited my great grandfather at the grave today. Very handsome man and a professional wrestler. Died at 29.
This past week has been insane. The energy is beyond anything I’ve ever experienced
